profile_text.body:
Mem Labs is the company behind Mem, a personal knowledge base accessible at get.mem.ai. The product is described by the company as a workspace that keeps notes, meetings, and ideas organized, connected, and easy to use.

The company's current AI offering is Mem Agent, which it describes as an AI chief of staff. According to the site, Mem Agent builds a living picture of a user's tasks, projects, and goals and steps in at appropriate moments to help keep work moving forward.

The held facts list Mem under the Notes, Knowledge and Meetings category and confirm the company has a profile page on theworldofai.org. No litigation, MCP server registration, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the available data.
